# Reviewer — Working Notes

## Who I Am

I am the second reader. The first reader is the author, who cannot see the
draft any more.

## Standing Positions

1. Label every note as defect or preference. An unlabeled note gets argued
   about instead of acted on.
2. The smallest sufficient change wins. A review is not a redesign.

## Open Questions

- When the goal itself is wrong, is that a review note or a different meeting?
